source.directorySummary: Implements the `init` file subcommand for initializing a Git repository in the resolved workspace, providing command definition, workspace-root adaptation, and git execution with existing-repository checks.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts FileCommandAdapterParams to handleInitCommand by resolving the workspace root via resolveFileWorkspaceRoot and returning the handler's text or the resolution error string.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Exports initDefinition factory that defines the `init` (alias `git-init`) subcommand metadata to initialize a Git repository in the workspace.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Implements handleInitCommand that checks `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree`, validates an existing `.git` path, and runs `git init` via Bun spawnSync returning ok/error text results.

summary.value: Implements the `init` file subcommand for initializing a Git repository in the resolved workspace, providing command definition, workspace-root adaptation, and git execution with existing-repository checks.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf git-bootstrap subcommand at the file plugin's aggregation boundary — fanned out from the centralized dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and registration (plugins/file/init.ts) alongside the other 19 file/git/bottom-up/transfer commands. Completes the git-operations family (commit/diff/history/restore/init) as the repository-creation entry point, reusing shared/resolveFileWorkspaceRoot for containment and isolating idempotency and Bun spawnSync execution in the handler so initialization remains decoupled from downstream git workflows.

files.adapter.ts: Workspace-boundary adapter for the init pipeline — translates FileCommandAdapterParams via shared/resolveFileWorkspaceRoot and delegates to handleInitCommand, surfacing handler text or resolution error string back to the central adapter dispatch without owning git logic.
files.definition.ts: Plugin-registration contract that publishes the `init` (alias `git-init`) metadata via initDefinition factory into the file plugin's 20-command registry; pure definition layer that enables adapter dispatch to route to this directory.
files.handler.ts: Idempotent execution core for repository bootstrap — pre-checks `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` and existing `.git` path before running `git init` via Bun spawnSync, returning normalized ok/error text and keeping git-process concerns separate from workspace resolution in the adapter.
